prerequisites: Participation in the Mathematical Preparatory Course is recommended.
Basic knowledge of vector calculus, differential and integral calculus.

learning_outcomes.text: Understanding of fundamental physical concepts such as force, work, energy, power, momentum, and angular momentum through questions of classical mechanics.
Mastery and confident application of central principles of physics such as conservation laws and knowledge of prototypical forms of motion such as rotational movements or harmonic oscillations.
Ability to independently apply conservation laws and methods such as setting up and solving equations of motion to solve simple physical problems.

syllabus_topics: Motion of mass points: Trajectory, Velocity, Acceleration, Free fall, Projectile motions, Circular motions

Dynamics of mass points: Inertia, Mass, Momentum, Equation of motion, Concept of force, Force equilibria, Special forces, Reaction principle, Conservation of momentum, Angular momentum, Torque, Conservation of angular momentum
Energy, Work and Power: Kinetic energy, Simple collisions, Work, Potential energy, Conservation of energy, Power
Gravitation: Law of gravitation, Gravitational fields, Work and potential energy in a gravitational field, Planetary motion
Harmonic oscillations: Free and damped oscillations, Forced oscillations
Mechanics of rigid bodies: Center of mass, Rotations around fixed axes, Rotational energy, Moment of inertia
